Examples.Title: Baixar artefato de jurisprudência
Examples.Description: Download de um artefato específico associado a uma jurisprudência.
Examples.Code:
### Baixar artefato de jurisprudência
# @name downloadJurisprudenceArtifact
GET {{host}}/jurisprudence/{{juit_id}}/artifact?owner={{owner}}&filename={{filename}}
Authorization: Basic {{credentials}}
Accept: application/json, application/octet-stream, application/pdf, application/rtf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Artefato baixado com sucesso.
# Content-Type: application/octet-stream, application/pdf, application/rtf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
# 400
# Description: Bad Request response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Server internal error response
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Buscar jurisprudências
Examples.Description: Esse endpoint realiza a busca na base da JUIT e retorna 10 jurisprudências.
Examples.Code:
### Buscar jurisprudências
# @name getJurisprudences
GET {{host}}/jurisprudence?query={{query}}&owner={{owner}}&search_id={{search_id}}&search_on={{search_on}}&disable_synonym_on={{disable_synonym_on}}&sort_by_field=[
  "score",
  "juit_id"
]&sort_by_direction=[
  "desc",
  "desc"
]&next_page_token={{next_page_token}}&order_date={{order_date}}&judgment_date={{judgment_date}}&publication_date={{publication_date}}&release_date={{release_date}}&signature_date={{signature_date}}&court_code={{court_code}}&degree={{degree}}&process_origin_state={{process_origin_state}}&district={{district}}&document_matter_list={{document_matter_list}}&process_class_name_list={{process_class_name_list}}&judgment_body={{judgment_body}}&trier={{trier}}&document_type={{document_type}}&justice_type={{justice_type}}
Authorization: Basic {{credentials}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Retrieved jurisprudences.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Unprocessably content error response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Server internal error response
# Content-Type: application/json
